jobs.employer: The Law Society of NSW (scheme-wide — all participating firms/organisations)
jobs.program: Summer Clerkship — 2027 NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program (2027/28 summer intake)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide window: applications open 9:00am AEST on 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am on 8 September 2027; 'closes' is null because the Law Society publishes two staggered closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027, both 11:59pm AEST) depending on the employer, and eligibility is normally penultimate (or final) year of an LLB/JD.

jobs.employer: The Law Society of NSW (scheme-wide — all participating firms/organisations)
jobs.program: Graduate Program — 2027 NSW Graduate Recruitment Program (market offers round)
jobs.notes: Market-offer round for final-year students: applications open 9:00am AEST 22 February 2027 and close 11:59pm AEST 4 April 2027, with interviews from 27 April 2027; individual employers may run their own additional processes within these dates.

jobs.program: Dive In 2027 (pre-penultimate year insight program, May 2027)
jobs.notes: Allens' own graduate site states the May 2027 Dive In program opens in March 2027 but publishes no exact open/close dates, so both are null; it is an insight program for pre-penultimate students (2nd/3rd-year LLB or 1st-year JD) rather than a clerkship, and Allens' 2026/27 clerkship round is already closed with no 2027/28 dates yet published.

jobs.program: Graduate Development Program (two-year program, applications opening May 2027)
jobs.notes: The CSO's official careers page confirms graduate applications open in May 2027 but gives no day-level open or close dates, so both fields are null; entry requires admission (or eligibility for admission) as a lawyer.
